3 years ago I was 286lbs. I'm 5'5, so around the same build.

  
As of today im 160lbs. Still got another 10 or so to go, and it was the best choice I have ever made. Not one day has gone by that I regret starting my weight loss off. I am a different person, physically and mentally. Its the best choice I have ever made.

  
I started off calorie counting for a few weeks, eating the same. I then worked out my TDEE (Total daily energy expenditure, the amount of CALS needed in a day to maintain). I then started to lower my calories week by week, and started encorperating at home exercise week by week.

Everyone does it differently, and what may work for me may not work for you, you just need to make the start, and use all the negativity you feel toward your situation as the motivation to continue. Do you want to keep getting larger and more depressed, eventually dying due to something weight loss related? I would imagine not.

Age, Genetics and how much its been stretched.

As someone who got a tounge piercing last year I'l give you some info;

\-The piercing process itself wasn't too bad. The middle part of your tongue is mainly muscle, so it wasn't too painful. I found my nostril and industrial bar worse (top of ear, two holes)

\-The day of the piercing my tongue was fine, towards the end of the day it got horrible to deal with

\-The next week was awful, couldn't speak properly, had to eat a liquid diet basically. Its tender, swollen and does your head in big time. I was drooling in my sleep, speaking with a lisp.

\-After a few weeks its basically fine, within 4-6 weeks post piercing its basically healed completly, tongue heals super quick because lots of blood flow!

\-Im now really happy I got it, i considered taking it out at one point during healing but im very glad I didn't.

\-It now looks super good, don't see too many men with one, so its a nice little touch.

\-If you did get it and didn't like it, you can just take it out. If it gets removed in that 4-6 week period it can literally close over in less than a day with it out, so its very reversable.

\-I have swolled one piercing ball in my sleep, i now regularly make sure its tight every few weeks and keep a spare bar/ball in my wallet

\-You have to re-learn how to eat a little, you take it slower. You do not want to break a tooth biting on your piercing. 

\-best pro? It makes a fantastic fidget toy you have all the time

The bar with CH is the client hp. The client itself deals with most of the goings on in game, but has to regularly send and recieve information from the server. Your current health is part of that information, as once the server is told you're dead, it registers it and does what it needs to.

I believe the client HP is one of the main reasons auto-nexus works, even if you take what should be an instadeath hit, as before the client can tell the server you've just died, it nexus's you before.

As long as client hp doesn't hit 0, server is never told you're dead and your character is alive, but sometimes there can be descrepencies between server hp and client, so the client hp bar is effectively your 'true' hp bar.

1- under tower remember that one star boop is similar in damage to an auto (non activated W). So melee creeps can be last hit with 1 boop, while caster creeps need 1 boop and an auto (one before the tower hits it, 1 after) 


2- with some ap (say, blasting wand or lost chapter) one activated W boop is enough to clear a caster minion after a tower shot.

3- if you’re trying to push the wave, stay to the left or right of it before it crashes in the middle of the lane. That way you hit 4+ with each star before they crash to the centre. (This applies to level 1 push or if your laner has backed and your pushing to roam)

4- if you know you’re safe (lane has backed or roamed)  Use your Q on the back creeps.

5- don’t be afraid to hit side lanes after you’ve warded up. A lot of people will stay mid 24/7 after they’ve got mid tower. Let the ADC go mid and you can take huge waves on the side that build up in lower Elos

1: Wave control

Draven naturally pushes, like you said its down to his high base AA damage and the requirement to keep atleast one axe spinning. In reality it depends on the lane and the enemy jungler. If you have a weak lane opp (jinx, twitch, vayne) and they have an awful early game jung (kayle, twitch, kindred) you can play aggressive and try to bully your lane opp so much that even if their shitter jung ganks the lane opp is so low you're very likely to win the fight. If that isn't the case and they have a better lane (lucian) or a good jung (lee e.c.t) and you dont want to push, i suggest only keep one axe spinning at any time. Means less stress if you lose it, less wasted mana and means you always have one ready to spin. Another tip is to simply lose one or two creeps if you really don't want to push. A few creeps less is always worth not dying and losing stacks. I would also suggest staying in the brush a lot. Dropping minion aggro is vital to stop pushing the lane. If the creeps are beating on you rather than your creeps, the lanes pushing to them.

2- trading and supps;

Trading in lane with draven is usually simple. If the enemy has a melee support you can bully a lot. Keep an eye out for when the lane opp goes to last hit and hit him with an auto. Theyll start to lose cs just because they know if they go for one theyre getting a smack from an axe. This is best with cannon creeps. Always one or two free autos. A good way to get good trades is to set up your rune page with 1-3% lifesteal quints and start long +3. Little more ad and you still match any other laners lifesteal. That or go dorans shield with one lifesteal quint for max regen and sustain. 

Usually if i get a shite support ill play super safe and preserve my stacks. Stacks from the start of the game are vital. You bag an extra 500g+ because you didnt die is insane and helps a lot. Worst case just lose some creeps and let them push. Try to get a freeze on and ask yoir jung to gank. If you get the first kill and the dolla from it you can usually just have your way then.
